outcome: Three versioned Agent task definitions run through a task runtime with User Story as the only required method pack
acceptance: planner, generator, and evaluator definitions include skills, tools, input and output schemas
planner output is rejected when it contains implementation file paths
generator cannot mark the slice accepted
evaluator pass cannot be replaced by generator self-check
evaluator revision-required produces a repair handoff to generator
user-story method adds a userStory artifact; omitting the method does not
missing required method skill blocks the planner task
task runs record skill versions and depth
assumptions: environment readiness is an input to Generator
